title: Scalable Quantum Machine Learning via Multi-layer Fully-Connected Variational Quantum Circuits
summary: Variational quantum circuits (VQCs) face an expressivity-trainability dilemma and scalability challenges. We propose Multi-Layer Fully-Connected Variational Quantum Circuits (FC-VQC), a general-purpose quantum machine learning framework that connects local VQC blocks through measurement, deterministic parameter-free routing, and re-encoding. All trainable model parameters reside within the quantum blocks, without trainable classical neural components.
